summary: Docs closed out: v1, Stage 1 and Stage 2 blueprints/Gantts/spec moved to Docs/archive/ with the tools and tests that read them repointed; README (en/zh/ja) and the execution spec name the v2 blueprint as the only authority, list frozen modules, gates and the G-LOAD(2000) result, and drop stale transport/run_stdio claims; two contradicted learn notes marked stale; the crossterm patch names upstream issues #1126 and #1142.

validation_result.validate_blueprint_v1: runs against Docs/archive/v1; reports the record superseded (authoritative: false)
validation_result.validate_stage1_blueprint: runs against Docs/archive/stage1; reports the selector inactive

notes: The legacy validators now run on the archived paths and return their verdicts on superseded records (exit 1 by design: they validate an active authority). The v1 validator accepts the superseded_at/superseded_by header keys ZE-100 added. Stage 2 protocol, user guide and Android notes stay in Docs/ as live references; the user guide links to the v2 blueprint.
